BotW Actor Tool (Rust + egui) — standalone actor editor for Breath of the Wild

A free, standalone actor editor for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild,
rewritten from the original Python tool in Rust + egui. No Python, no
dependencies — just a single .exe.

=====================================================================
WHAT IT DOES
=====================================================================
Edit an actor's data files directly: Actor Link, every link file as YAML
(AAMP/BYML), Texts (MSBT), ActorInfo and GameData Flags. On save it
regenerates ActorInfo.product.sbyml, the text files and the GameData
flags (gamedata.ssarc / savedataformat.ssarc) automatically.

Features
- Open vanilla actors (Ctrl+N) or actors from a mod directory (Ctrl+O),
  including TitleBG.pack-resident actors and *_Far variants.
- Actor Link panel: name + priority, every link as Dummy / ActorName /
  Custom, custom-file import, tags.
- VS Code-style YAML editors for every link file: line numbers, syntax
  highlighting, an accurate caret, and a find bar (Ctrl+F) with match
  highlighting, Enter-to-jump and a case toggle.
- Texts tab: BaseName / Name / Desc / PictureBook per language.
- ActorInfo tab: previews every field regenerated on save, with manual
  overrides and a "keep extra fields" option.
- Flags tab: lists the GameData flags (bool/s32) for the actor — edit
  values, add or delete flags.
- Localized UI: English / 中文 (independent of the game's text language).
- Dark mode with a complete theme and boosted text contrast.
- Settings toggle to show the unsupported Elink/Profile/Slink/Xlink tabs.

=====================================================================
INSTALL / RUN
=====================================================================
1. Unzip anywhere and run botw_actor_tool_rs.exe (no install required).
2. Open Settings and set your Game / Update / DLC directories (unpacked
   ROM directories).
3. Ctrl+N: pick a vanilla actor from the update directory.
4. Ctrl+O: pick your mod's content or romfs directory, then an actor.
5. Ctrl+S: pick the mod directory to save (must be named content for
   big-endian/Wii U or romfs for little-endian/Switch).

Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable
(vc_redist) if it is missing.
